origin: FineWeb2, published by Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-2 . One shard downloaded: data/fas_Arab/train/000_00000.parquet (4618.1 MB, 2645000 rows) via the Hub's resolve URL with curl, no Python in the workflow. Converted with apps/convert: one JSON object per line carrying all 11 columns, with the per-language adapter's source thresholds applied (language_score >= 0.65, minhash_cluster_size <= 100). 8.3 percent of rows were dropped by the cluster bound and none by the language score. This file is a 48000-document prefix of that output, written as plain text.

FineWeb-Edu, published by Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu . One shard of the 10BT sample downloaded: sample/10BT/000_00000.parquet (2053.1 MB, 726000 rows) via the Hub's resolve URL with curl and resume, no Python in the workflow. Converted with apps/convert, which applied the English adapter's source thresholds: language_score >= 0.80 and the dataset's own educational-quality score >= 3.0 of 5, from the classifier that produced it. 79883 rows were dropped by the quality floor. This file is a 60000-document prefix of the survivors. FineWeb-Edu replaces Project Gutenberg, which carried no quality metadata and whose vocabulary is a century old; both halves of the corpus now come from the same family, with one toolchain and one filtering philosophy.
